تستأوون (form X)
# تَسْتَأْوُونَ (tastaʔwūna) /tas.taʔ.wuː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِسْتَأْوَى (istaʔwā)
# تُسْتَأْوَوْنَ (tustaʔwawna) /tus.taʔ.waw.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِسْتَأْوَى (istaʔwā)
